data.one_liner: Converts Quill's Delta format to HTML.
data.what_it_does: Converts Quill Delta formatted data into HTML with support for nested lists, inline styles, and various custom attributes. It operates as a complete port of the quill-delta-to-html TypeScript package.
use_when: You need to convert rich text from a Quill editor (such as Flutter Quill) into HTML format.
You are generating HTML-based emails using Quill content on the server-side or in Flutter.
avoid_when: You need to parse HTML back into Quill Delta format.
strengths: Full support for Quill operations including images, videos, formulas, tables, and mentions.
Configurable options for output tags, sanitization, and inline styles.
